svg.title: Alicia — generative ASCII flower garden
svg.desc: Same ASCII particles disperse and morph into spring lily of the valley, summer dandelion, autumn sunflower and winter camellia over a 32-second loop. The ALICIA wordmark decodes into place, shimmers and tints with each season while petals, seeds, leaves and snow drift through the garden. Reduced-motion mode displays spring without animation.
svg.text: // ART IN CODE. CODE IN BLOOM.
teaching agents to show their evidence
